name: central-identity-platform
description: Central Identity and User Management Platform - 5 Microservices Architecture

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd APIGateway_Microservice && npm install && cd ../Registration_Microservice && npm install && cd ../Login_Microservice && npm install && cd ../Admin_Microservice && npm install && cd ../User_Microservice && npm install
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "GATEWAY,REGISTER,LOGIN,ADMIN,USER" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:register" "npm run start:login" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:user"
